message.reasoning:
I'm in jail with $901 cash while GPT 5.5 has only $51, and most of the board is mortgaged. Gemini and Grok are essentially bankrupt with no assets left. My plan is to stay defensive and let GPT land on my light-blue properties—Oriental and Vermont for $550, Connecticut for $600—to drain his remaining funds. The main threat is if I land on GPT's green properties before he goes under.

Being in jail actually works perfectly for me: I still collect rent when opponents land on my hotels, but I avoid the risk of landing on GPT's expensive green spread. Since GPT is so close to bankruptcy and has minimal income from his mortgaged properties, I want him to keep circling the board and hitting my hotels while I stay locked up and safe. Rolling for doubles is my best move—it keeps me in jail 5/6 of the time without costing money or using my get-out-of-jail card, and the 1/6 chance I'm forced out is acceptable since GPT will likely hit my properties soon anyway.
